_about: Features that were fixed or built and must not be broken again. Each entry names the source files that implement it and the tests that guard it. tests/test_feature_ledger.py fails if a guard test or source file disappears. Add an entry in the same PR as every fix or feature (CONTRIBUTING.md section 10). hand_verified says honestly what has and has not been seen in a real QGIS session.

features.feature: A file download whose redirected hop (urllib with QGIS proxy dictionary) is answered with 403, 407 or a 5xx status is retried once through the QGIS network stack, which carries PAC/system proxy, proxy authentication and the SSL setup; a refusal the server really gives is raised unchanged. The Host header of the first request is no longer copied to the redirected request (S3 answered SignatureDoesNotMatch). A failed boundary download says which site, what failed and what to try without printing the signed link. Affects fetch_hdx_admin_boundaries, fetch_geoboundaries and every other download through net.stream_following
features.hand_verified: not verified on the owner machine for HDX. geoBoundaries Yemen ADM1 loaded on the owner machine with the retry on 2026-10-26.
